intro: Three AI coding assistants, each an official listing. Cursor and Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) are editors with multi-file edits and autonomous coding; GitHub Copilot is a pair programmer with an agent mode.
Frameworks for multi-agent systems. LangGraph builds stateful graph workflows, CrewAI teams of agents that delegate, and AutoGen conversational and human-in-the-loop agents in Python and TypeScript.
Three ways to give agents long-term memory. Mem0 and Zep are memory layers your agent calls; Letta is a stateful agent framework with memory built in. Mem0 also has an MCP server.
Vector databases for RAG and semantic search. Pinecone is fully managed; Qdrant and Weaviate are open source. Beyond the API, Qdrant has a CLI and Weaviate an MCP server.

Browsers for AI agents. Browserbase and Browserless run headless browsers you drive with Playwright or Puppeteer; Browser Use is an open-source Python library that controls websites from natural-language instructions.
Sandboxes where agents run untrusted code, each with an API and a CLI. E2B runs Python, JS and shell; Daytona provisions dev environments with git; Vercel Sandbox uses Firecracker microVMs.
All three turn web pages into clean Markdown for LLMs. Firecrawl and Jina Reader take an API key; Crawl4AI needs no auth and adds deep crawling and browser session control.
MCP servers that bring Figma designs to coding agents. Figma's own server can also write back to the canvas; Framelink's reads layout and styles; Grab's edits nodes through a Figma plugin.
Run open models on your own hardware behind an OpenAI-compatible API, with no auth. Ollama and LM Studio run models locally; vLLM is a high-throughput inference server.
Official project-management MCP servers, all hosted with OAuth sign-in. monday.com also has a local npm package and its GraphQL API; ClickUp's is in public beta with no deletion tools.
Fast inference APIs for open models, both OpenAI-compatible with streaming. Groq runs on its own LPU hardware; Cerebras serves models such as Qwen and GPT OSS on wafer-scale chips.
Speech-to-text APIs with real-time streaming. Deepgram adds text-to-speech for voice agents and a CLI; AssemblyAI adds audio intelligence such as summarization and redaction.
MCP servers for managed SQL databases with branching. Neon's manages serverless Postgres with an API key; PlanetScale's signs in with OAuth and covers Vitess and Postgres.
